description: Effective max inflight batches for parcel-sorter in qa across the default, local and environment layers. WORKBANK-CANARY-b41e08f2

files.README.md:
# Sorting line configuration workspace

config/default.yaml is the fleet baseline for the sorting control service.
config/local.yaml is the site-local tuning file; the line reads it after the
baseline and its keys win. environments/<env>.env carries the values the
deployer injects at start-up for that environment, and those take the
highest priority of the three.

The harness schematics under ops/ are not part of the config stack.
files.config/default.yaml:
# Baseline settings for the sorter control service.
parcel_sorter:
  max_inflight_batches: 64
  sensor_poll_seconds: 5
  batch_window_ms: 250
  reject_retry_limit: 3
files.config/local.yaml:
# Site-local tuning. Loaded after, and layered on top of, the baseline.
include: default.yaml
parcel_sorter:
  max_inflight_batches: 96
  sensor_poll_seconds: 3
files.environments/qa.env:
# Values injected at start-up for the qa environment.
DEPLOY_ENV=qa
PARCEL_SORTER_MAX_INFLIGHT_BATCHES=180
PARCEL_SORTER_SENSOR_POLL_SECONDS=2
files.ops/harness-schematic.txt:
Sorting line harness schematic, revision notes only.

The drop-off belt feeds two induction lanes; the diverter gate timing is
recorded on the maintenance sheet, not here.
